To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
bioactive glass in the SiO2–P2O3–Na2O system was prepared from sand in place of TEOS or TMOS.
a novel bioactive glass was developed from sand as precursor, which is a cheaper alternative to TEOS and TMOS.

the glass monoliths prepared from sodium metasilicate extracted directly from sand and processed to a gel through sol-gel technique were found to be bioactive in vitro and the bioactivity was enhanced by the formation of Na2Ca2Sio9 crystals in the glass.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the transformation of sand into bioactive glass and its application in the regeneration of bone defects.
the development of a new method to prepare bioactive glass in the SiO2–P2O 5–CaO–Na2O system using a precursor from sand in place of alkoxide.
the transformation of sand derived bioactive glass to bioactive glass-ceramics.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
bioactive glass from sand was successfully transformed from sol-gel derived bioactive glass from alkoxysilane.
sand can be a useful precursor in the preparation of biocompatible glass.
sand is a suitable precursor to prepare bioactive glass in place of the alkoxysilane.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
sand can be used as an alternative to the alkoxysilicates in the preparation of bioactive glasses.
bioactive glass can be synthesized from sand, and the glass is capable of transforming to HA/HCA in SBF, and therefore, can be used for bone regeneration.
the sol-gel derived bioactive glass from sand is an excellent substitute for the alkoxysilane derived bioactive glass.
The main takeaway from our work is that
bioactive glass can be produced from sand, an inexpensive and readily available resource, in place of alkoxide precursor.
sand can be used as precursor to synthesize bioactive glass for the regeneration of trabaculr bone.
sand can be used as an alternative to alkoxysilane in the production of bioglass.
